title: K1262 Phase 2: TF/MR scaling × window × adoption robustness sweep
description: Phase 2 robustness sweep on K1261 TF/MR results. Loop: 2 treatments × 4 scaling × 3 window × 7 adoption × 100 MC = 16800 sims. Tests caveat #4 from K1261 code review: H1+ direction robust but threshold magnitude may be specification-dependent (TF/MR scaling=10 may be aggressive).

config.seed_formula: int(adoption*100000) + sim_idx + 42 + scaling*1000 + window*10 (extends K1261 formula to disambiguate sweep cells)

note_on_k1261_input.usage: Part B (softer_detector_table.md) recomputes K1261 raw results under 3 detector variants. Read at analysis time, not by k1262.py main loop.
